blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–With a long season winding down, it is no surprise that the grind of competing at the highest level would take its toll on Alex Eala. The Filipino world No. 17, however, emphasized that exhaustion is a necessary part of her job as a professional tennis player on the WTA Tour.
